name: Validate and forward to ML
func: if(flow.get('input_mode')==='hardware')return null; const p=msg.payload; if(!p || !['voltage','current','temperature'].every(k=>Number.isFinite(p[k]))) {node.warn('Invalid simulator reading');return null;} msg.payload=p; msg.headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'}; return msg;

name: Publish latest processed reading
func: if(msg.statusCode!==200 || !msg.payload || !msg.payload.prediction){node.warn('ML gateway returned error');return null;} const p=msg.payload; const mode=flow.get('input_mode')||'simulation';if((mode==='hardware')!==(!p.sim))return null; p.pipeline=mode==='hardware'?'ESP32 → MQTT → NODE-RED → FLASK ML → NODE-RED':'SIMULATOR → NODE-RED → FLASK ML → NODE-RED';p.input_mode=mode;p.received_at=new Date().toISOString();flow.set('latest',p);if(mode==='hardware')flow.set('hardware_at',p.received_at);return msg;

name: Latest from Node-RED
func: msg.headers={'Access-Control-Allow-Origin':'*','Cache-Control':'no-store'};const p=flow.get('latest');if(!p){msg.statusCode=503;msg.payload={error:'waiting for first processed reading',mode:flow.get('input_mode')||'simulation'};return msg;}if(Date.now()-Date.parse(p.received_at||p.timestamp)>12000){msg.statusCode=503;msg.payload={error:'stale telemetry - sensor input disconnected',mode:flow.get('input_mode')||'simulation'};return msg;}msg.payload=p;return msg;

name: Hardware mode + sensor validation
func: if(flow.get('input_mode')!=='hardware')return null; const p=msg.payload; if(!p || p.sensor_ok!==true || !['voltage','current','temperature'].every(k=>typeof p[k]==='number' && Number.isFinite(p[k]))) {node.warn('ESP32 invalid sensor reading');return null;} if(p.voltage<0||p.voltage>300||p.current<0||p.current>100||p.temperature< -55||p.temperature>125){node.warn('ESP32 out-of-range telemetry');return null;} msg.payload={voltage:p.voltage,current:p.current,temperature:p.temperature,power:p.power,source:'ESP32',sim:false,scenario:'hardware',sensor_ok:true,hardware_relay:p.relay,trip_reason:p.trip_reason,edge_label:p.edge_label,timestamp:new Date().toISOString()};msg.headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'};return msg;

name: Select simulation or hardware
func: const mode=msg.payload && msg.payload.mode;msg.headers={'Access-Control-Allow-Origin':'*','Cache-Control-Allow-Headers':'Content-Type','Cache-Control-Allow-Methods':'GET, POST, OPTIONS','Cache-Control':'no-store'};if(!['simulation','hardware'].includes(mode)){msg.statusCode=400;msg.payload={error:'mode must be simulation or hardware'};return msg;}flow.set('input_mode',mode);flow.set('latest',null);msg.payload={ok:true,mode:mode,notice:'Mode changed. Awaiting fresh readings.'};return msg;
